body:
## What's new

- **Download progress.** Telamon Updater shows how much of an update is downloaded, then each install step.
- **Changelog.** Every version this computer went through, with its notes.
- Restart Tonight: one click restarts at 11 PM.

Full details on [GitHub](https://github.com/EternalCoder454/AtlasOS/releases).

## What's new

- Updates also work on systems with packages added through `rpm-ostree install`.
- Faster dock and launcher animations.

- Kernel 7.2.6
- Mesa 26.2.3 with fixes for RDNA 3 cards
- First release on the stable channel.
- Older than this computer: not shown.
